questions.q: What does a Data Source record actually configure in ServiceNow?
options: Where external data comes from and the connection details needed to read it — not any field mapping
The field-level mapping between staging and target table columns
The coalesce setting used to decide between inserting and updating records
The transform script that runs once data reaches the target table
questions.explain: A Data Source only defines the connection and format of the source data. Mapping is the Transform Map's job in Lesson 26.

questions.q: Which of these is a real, supported ServiceNow Data Source type for pulling directly from an external relational database?
options: JDBC
A hand-typed copy-paste import
A screenshot-based OCR import
A print-to-PDF import
questions.explain: JDBC lets ServiceNow query another system's database tables directly using a driver and connection string.

questions.q: What is the difference between running 'Load All Records' manually and setting up a Scheduled Import?
options: Manual loading runs on demand for one-time or irregular loads; a Scheduled Import ties a Data Source to a recurring schedule for repeated loads
There is no real difference; both only work once
A Scheduled Import replaces the need for a Data Source entirely
Manual loading is only available for JDBC source types
questions.explain: Scheduled Import automates a recurring load; manual loading suits a one-off or irregular import.

questions.q: Which Data Source type is designed to read a file sitting on a remote server, rather than one uploaded by hand?
options: FTP/SFTP
File upload only
Web Service (SOAP) exclusively
There is no such source type
questions.explain: FTP/SFTP points at a file on a remote server, useful when another system drops files on its own schedule.

questions.q: If data isn't landing in the Import Set staging table at all, where should you look first per this lesson's separation of concerns?
options: The Data Source configuration or its Scheduled Import, since those are what actually populate the staging table
The Transform Map's coalesce field setting
The target table's field mapping
The Transform Map's Run Script logic
questions.explain: If staging itself is empty, the problem is upstream — the Data Source or its schedule — not the Transform Map, which only runs after staging is populated.
